briefing.headline: OpenAI o5 multi-agent release escalates AGI race as compute and safety bottlenecks intensify

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate releases amid geopolitical tensions. Compute constraints and regulatory scrutiny shape deployment strategies across sectors.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o5-preview with native multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic deploys Claude 4 Opus. xAI Grok-3 and DeepSeek-R2 post record benchmark gains.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins next quarter.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra ramp hits 2M units monthly; Microsoft and Google announce joint 500MW data center expansions in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will first AGI system emerge before 2028 scaling plateaus or will regulatory caps intervene?
